title: Mobile Hotspot Service Terms of the Student Technology Device Program
content:
The Student Technology Device Program records four hotspot terms against every loan type: the data service, the ground on which a hotspot is loaned, the most hotspots one household may hold at a time, and how long a hotspot loan lasts. Only the Mobile Hotspot Loan carries hotspot service; on the learning-device loan types the service terms read "not applicable".

## Terms by loan type

| Loan type | Data service | Ground on which a hotspot is loaned | Most hotspots loaned to one household at a time | Length of a hotspot loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | Not applicable | Not applicable | 1 | Not applicable |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Not applicable | Not applicable | 1 | Not applicable |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Not applicable | Not applicable | 1 | Not applicable |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | Not applicable | Not applicable | 1 | Not applicable |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Not applicable | Not applicable | 1 | Not applicable |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | Filtered unlimited data | The household's statement that it has no home internet service | 1 | The school year |

## The Mobile Hotspot Loan in short

- **Data service**: filtered, unlimited.
- **Ground of the loan**: the household's own statement that it has no home internet service.
- **Household limit**: 1 hotspot loaned to one household at a time.
- **Length**: one school year.
